mapper.select: select * from (select a.*, rank() over (partition by product_code order by create_time desc ,id desc ) as xh from ${dynamicTableNameProxy.productCostFollow} a where create_time >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '8 days' and product_code =#{id} and delete_flag = false and enterprise_code = ${dynamicTableNameProxy.enterpriseCode}) where xh = 1
